data: Tesla's operating income was about $8.89 billion in fiscal 2023, but I can't give you a reliable fiscal 2025 full-year figure, so I can't calculate the percentage change. Tesla's first three quarters of 2025 total roughly $3.5 billion, but I don't have a verified fourth-quarter number to complete the year. Tesla's 10-K for fiscal 2025, filed in early 2026, would give the exact full-year operating income, and with that figure the change is (FY2025 − $8.89B) ÷ $8.89B × 100.
